title: Scoped Backprop verification report
description: A reviewed deterministic checker adapter's result (goobers.dev/backprop/verification/v1). The adapter checks proofs; Backprop checks recorded provenance, not theorem validity. Runtime additionally bounds the encoded report to 16 KiB, checks sanitized text and byte lengths, requires prior artifact provenance, and limits a run to 128 reports. Example digests are placeholders, not actual checker evidence.

schema.description: Version of the checker report contract.

property.description: Stable identifier of the scoped property checked.

subject.description: Recorded exact source, binary, or input package checked.

context.description: Recorded manifest of stable dependencies, semantics, bounds, and other execution assumptions; subject-specific proof artifacts belong in evidence.

checker.description: Trusted independent checker identity, not the proof-generation agent.

digest.description: Content digest of the checker executable.

assumptions.description: Explicit assumptions; an empty array means none. Ordering must match for a repair link.

outcome.description: Scoped checker result. Failed proof search alone is inconclusive, not a counterexample.

evidence.description: Previously recorded proof, checker, or counterexample artifacts; conclusive outcomes require at least one.

repairs.description: Explicit earlier verification record ID in this run. Only proven reports may name a repair; runtime separately checks counterexample identity and scope.

reference.description: Bounded printable reference without whitespace; runtime also rejects control and format characters.

text.description: Bounded sanitized text; runtime rejects control/format characters and noncanonical whitespace.
